user.title: Heater components
user.description: Choose the entities that make up this heater.

data_description.heater_switch: The switch that turns the heater on and off.
data_description.temperature_sensors: One or more sensors. Usable ones are averaged; a failed or stale one is ignored.
data_description.power_sensor: Tells whether the heater is actually heating.

data_description.cold_tolerance: Heater turns on when the temperature drops to target minus this value.
data_description.hot_tolerance: Heater turns off when the temperature reaches target plus this value.
data_description.power_threshold: Above this power the heater counts as heating.
data_description.stale_hours: A temperature sensor that has not reported for this long is ignored (max 24 h).
data_description.min_cycle_minutes: Minimum time the switch stays on or off before the thermostat changes it again. 0 disables. Mode changes and boost ignore this.
data_description.max_boost_minutes: Upper limit of the boost slider (max 60 min).

error.max_below_min: Maximum temperature must be higher than minimum temperature.
error.target_out_of_range: Default target must be between minimum and maximum temperature.
error.no_temperature_sensor: Select at least one temperature sensor.

abort.already_configured: This switch is already used by another heater.
